We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We attempted applying 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (list of three). Need to select one that can be further processed with next template 1914389, etc.

The result from 29646 gave three precursors:

1. 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C' (looks like target with silyl protecting group on primary alcohol)
2. 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO' (silyl on carboxylate? Actually O[Si] attached to acid)
3. 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO' (silyl on secondary alcohol)

We need to apply template 1914389 next. We tried applying to first precursor and got two products: 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C' and 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC' (looks like maybe a side product). So 1914389 applied to first precursor gave a new precursor (with CC=O). Good.

Now next template 1914390 applied to that new precursor gave empty result. So maybe need different branch.

We need a chain of 5 reactions. Perhaps we need to choose appropriate precursors at each step.

We can also use other templates later: 149040 and 1914391.

We need to construct a route JSON with each reaction node using given template IDs in order.

We need to find a sequence where each template is applicable.

We can try to apply 1914389 to second precursor from 29646? Let's test.
